fusions.name: Level Regard
fusions.desc: Sends a bolt of light along your gaze, dealing 26 damage that ignores resistances and leaving the target [Marked] for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: All-Round Watch
fusions.desc: Looks all the way round you at once, dealing 11 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave each [Marked] for 6 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to enemies within 3 tiles of it.

fusions.name: Settled Sight
fusions.desc: Increases your critical hit chance by 25% for 15 seconds and restores 8 health.

fusions.name: Never Fully Asleep
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your dodge chance rises by 10%.
